senses.gloss: f. (צָבַט) seizing, handling; בית הצ׳ that part of a vessel by which it is seized, handle, neck, cavity for the fingers, &c.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Chagigah 3:1">Ḥag. III, 1</cite> (<cite ref="Chagigah 20b:7">20ᵇ</cite>) <he>אחוריים ותוך ובית הצ׳</he> (Y. ed. <he>ובית צביעה</he>) (in vessels used for T’rumah) the back (outside), the inside, and the handle are considered as independent of one another (one becoming unclean does not affect the others). Ib. 22ᵇ <he>בית הצ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>הצְבָטָה</he>), v. <cite ref="R00031"><he>צָבַט</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 25:7">Kel. XXV, 7</cite>, sq. R. S. (ed. <he>צביע׳</he>). V. <cite ref="R00045"><he>צְבִיעָה</he></cite>.
